newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies six issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies six issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp on Thursday said that it qualified for bond insurance the following six municipal bond issues, which are scheduled to be sold competitively:
--Pittsburg Unified School District, Calif., $5 million general obligations.
--Roxbury, Community School District, N.Y., $2.7 million school bonds.
--Roxbury, Community School District, N.Y., $900,000 school bonds.
--Lexington County Recreation District, S.C., $7.3 million GO refunding bonds.
